title: The privacy and terms pages replaced the root robots block and lost the Google preview directives

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-metadata finder). app/privacy/page.tsx and app/terms/page.tsx set robots {index: true, follow: true}; the root layout's own comment says a nested robots replaces the block wholesale, so the two pages dropped googleBot max-image-preview: large, max-snippet: -1 and max-video-preview: -1 for no gain (the root already says index + follow). CLOSED 2026-10-05: the override is gone and both inherit the root block.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const bad=["app/privacy/page.tsx","app/terms/page.tsx"].filter((p)=>/robots: \{ index: true, follow: true \}/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")));if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-677: "+bad.join(", ")+" set robots {index, follow} and so replace the root block wholesale, dropping the googleBot max-image-preview/max-snippet directives on the two legal pages.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
